name: Gratex Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, Gratex Industries Ltd manufactures Paper & Paper Products.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
GIL is in the business of manufacturing and 
trading of:
a) Wall Papers
b) Wall Posters
c) Profiles
d) Catalogues
e) Furniture
f) Other related products

pros: Debtor days have improved from 60.0 to 35.0 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 1.56% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.77% over last 3 years.
